meta.title: Trading name stated in footer; sponsorship offered; fully sponsorable

payload.requisition_text:
Senior-track Software Engineer II — Brightgate
Holborn, London (3 days office)

Brightgate is the compliance platform for UK letting agents: deposits, right-to-rent checks, gas certificates, all tracked and audit-ready. 2,100 agencies run on us.

What the job is
Owning features end to end in a Django + React codebase with unusually good tests. Recent projects: an e-signature flow, a document OCR pipeline, a landlord payment ledger.

What we need
2+ years with a mainstream backend framework. You write about your decisions clearly. You have opinions about naming things.

Pay and process
£45,000. Pension matched to 5%. Visa sponsorship is available for this position. One take-home (90 minutes, paid), one onsite.

Brightgate is a trading name of Marlowe & Finch Technology Ltd.

expected.determining_fact: Marlowe & Finch Technology Ltd (trading as Brightgate) holds an A-rated Skilled Worker licence, offers sponsorship for this role, and the salary clears both thresholds.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: Visa sponsorship is available for this position

design_notes: Companion to case-05: same trading_name_stated mechanism, but with an explicit offer, so the ground truth is a full SPONSORABLE through the footer-resolution path. The ampersand in the legal name exercises normalisation.
